chatbot.welcome: Hi! I'm your Skilled Ustaad Assistant. How can I help you with your booking today?
chatbot.error: I'm having a bit of trouble connecting to my central brain. Please try again or email support@skilledustaad.com
chatbot.title: KB Assistant
chatbot.a1: To verify arrival, enter the 6-digit OTP provided by the customer when you arrive at the job location. To complete the service, enter the final completion OTP provided by the customer after finishing the work.
chatbot.a2: Payouts are processed within 24-48 business hours. Once a job is marked 'Completed' and the balance is settled by the customer, the transfer to your primary bank account is automatically initiated.
chatbot.a3: Your profile status can be 'Pending', 'Active', or 'Suspended'. If your status is 'Pending', our admin team is reviewing your documents (ID proof, address proof, trade credentials, and background check). This usually takes 24-48 hours.
chatbot.a4: To accept a job, you can browse open opportunities in the Live Marketplace and submit a bid with your cost, timeline, and proposal. Alternatively, direct bookings will appear on your Dashboard where you can accept them.
chatbot.a5: You can add new payment methods (Bank Account/UPI) in the Earnings tab. However, for security reasons, modifications to your primary verified bank details or government ID proof must be done by contacting support.
chatbot.a6: You can install Skilled Ustaad on your phone as a mobile app. Just open this portal on your browser, click 'Install App' in the sidebar (or follow the browser prompt to Add to Home Screen), and launch it directly from your home screen.

help.faq_q1: How soon do I get paid after completing a job?
help.faq_a1: Settlements are processed within 24-48 hours. Once a job is marked 'Completed' and the balance is settled by the customer, our automated clearing system initiates the transfer to your primary bank account.
help.faq_q2: What should I do if a customer asks for a different price?
help.faq_a2: All pricing must be finalized through the Skilled Ustaad platform. Taking payments outside the platform or changing prices without an official quote update violates our partner agreement and can lead to account suspension.
help.faq_q3: I'm not receiving new job notifications. Why?
help.faq_a3: Check if you have toggled your 'Online' status to ON. Also, ensure that your profile is fully verified (KYC complete) and your location permissions are enabled on your device.
help.faq_q4: How can I update my service categories?
help.faq_a4: You can update your skills via 'Profile Settings > Service Details'. Please note that significant changes may require re-verification or additional documentation of your expertise.
